import java.util.*;

class Solution {
    public static Object solve(Map<String,Object> data) {
        List<String> queries = (List<String>) data.get("queries");
        List<String> words = (List<String>) data.get("words");
        
        Map<String, Boolean> result = new HashMap<>();
        
        for (String query : queries) {
            String type = query.split(":")[0];
            String word = query.split(":")[1].trim();
            
            switch (type) {
                case "exact":
                    result.put(word, words.contains(word));
                    break;
                case "prefix":
                    boolean found = false;
                    for (String w : words) {
                        if (w.startsWith(word)) {
                            found = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    result.put(word, found);
                    break;
            }
        }
        
        return result.values().toArray(new Boolean[0]);
    }
}

import java.util.*;

class Solution {
    public static List<Boolean> solve(Map<String, Object> data) {
        List<Object> queries = (List<Object>) data.get("queries");
        List<String> words = (List<String>) data.get("words");
        
        Set<String> wordSet = new HashSet<>(words);
        List<Boolean> results = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (Object queryObj : queries) {
            Map<String, Object> query = (Map<String, Object>) queryObj;
            String type = (String) query.get("type");
            String word = (String) query.get("word");
            
            switch (type) {
                case "prefix":
                    results.add(wordSet.contains(word));
                    break;
                case "exact":
                    results.add(wordSet.contains(word) && word.equals(word.toLowerCase()));
                    break;
                default:
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid query type");
            }
        }
        
        return results;
    }
}

import java.util.*;

class Solution {
    public static List<Boolean> solve(Map<String, Object> data) {
        Map<String, Integer> map = new HashMap<>();
        List<Map.Entry<String, Integer>> sortedEntries = new ArrayList<>(map.entrySet());
        Collections.sort(sortedEntries, Comparator.comparingInt(e -> e.getValue()));
        
        List<Boolean> results = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : data.get("queries")) {
            String type = (String) entry.get("type");
            String word = (String) entry.get("word");
            
            int count = 0;
            if ("exact".equals(type)) {
                count = map.getOrDefault(word, 0);
            } else {
                for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> e : sortedEntries) {
                    if (e.getKey().startsWith(word)) {
                        count += e.getValue();
                    }
                }
            }
            
            results.add(count > 0);
        }
        
        return results;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Test cases
        System.out.println(solve(Map.of(
            "queries",
            Arrays.asList(
                Map.of("type", "prefix", "word", ""),
                Map.of("type", "exact", "word", "ca")
            ),
            "words",
            Arrays.asList()
        ))); // Expected output: [false]
        
        System.out.println(solve(Map.of(
            "queries",
            Arrays.asList(
                Map.of("type", "prefix", "word", "ca"),
                Map.of("type", "exact", "word", "ca")
            ),
            "words",
            Arrays.asList("cat", "car")
        ))); // Expected output: [true, false]
        
        System.out.println(solve(Map.of(
            "queries",
            Arrays.asList(
                Map.of("type", "exact", "word", "a")
            ),
            "words",
            Arrays.asList("a", "ab")
        ))); // Expected output: [true]
        
        System.out.println(solve(Map.of(
            "queries",
            Arrays.asList(
                Map.of("type", "prefix", "word", "b")
            ),
            "words",
            Arrays.asList("aaa")
        ))); // Expected output: [false]
    }
}

            if ("exact".equals(type)) {
                result = words.contains(word);
            } else if ("prefix".equals(type)) {
                result = words.stream().anyMatch(w -> w.startsWith(word));
            } else {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid query type");
            }

            queryResults.put(word, result);
        }

        return new ArrayList<>(queryResults.values());
